subject: SLA credit request: API latency incident (2027-10-02) — Boreal Data
messages:
From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@borealdata.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@borealdata.com>, Boreal Data Billing <billing@borealdata.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA credit request following Oct 2 API latency spike

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the postmortem published yesterday. Boreal Data saw a significant increase in tail latency on 2027-10-02 between 03:20 and 03:47 UTC which impacted our inference pipeline. Our account team captured the customer-facing impact and we estimate ~18,400 impacted inference requests during the window.

Can Redwood confirm whether Boreal Data is eligible for an SLA credit for this event, and if eligible, provide a proposed credit amount and timeline for issuance? We need the documentation and calculation to reconcile against our internal billing.

Attaching our incident timeline and a quick summary. Let me know if you need any more detail.

Thanks,
Janelle Park
Head of Platform Reliability
Boreal Data

Attachment: boreal-incident-summary-20271002.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle.park@borealdata.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>, Kim Park <kimberly@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SLA credit request following Oct 2 API latency spike

Hi Janelle —

Thanks for the note and for sharing Boreal's timeline. We've reviewed the postmortem and are evaluating eligibility under the SLA. Short answer: you likely qualify for a partial credit under the uptime/latency clause, but we need to validate the exact impact window and token/request counts from our telemetry.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll kick off a calc with Finance to quantify the credit (Marcus).
- Kim will pull the per-customer token/request counts and confirm the overlap with the degraded nodes.
- We will share a draft credit calculation and the supporting evidence within 5 business days.

Appreciate the attached timeline. We'll be in touch by Oct 8 with a proposed credit amount and resolution path.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.inference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0126

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: SLA credit request — Boreal Data (needs calc + approval)

Team — forwarding Boreal's request. Key asks: eligibility confirmation, proposed credit amount, and confirmation of issuance path (credit memo vs invoice adjustment).

Highlights from postmortem: 03:20–03:47 UTC degraded p95/p99 due to a kernel scheduling regression on a subset of serving fleet. Boreal is reporting ~18.4k impacted requests in the window.

Action items:
- Marcus: can Finance run the credit calc using our standard formula (pro-rata for impacted time / committed monthly spend) and include token-based adjustments? I've attached the incident timeline and the customer summary from the previous message.
- Kim: please export the per-customer request/token counts for Boreal for Oct 2 and mark confirmed impacted requests.
- Vanessa: if approval is needed beyond your normal sign-off (>$25k), flag it so we can route to Ops/Leadership.

Attachments: incident-timeline-2027-10-02.pdf (attached), initial-customer-summary.pdf (attached)

Thanks — appreciate fast turnaround on this.
Hannah

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 11:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: SLA credit request — Boreal Data (calc attached)

Hi team —

I've completed a preliminary credit calculation and attached the workbook (credits_calc_v1.xlsx). Summary:
- Confirmed impacted requests: 18,372 (matches Boreal's estimate within margin).
- Monthly committed spend (Boreal): $63,500 (monthly committed Dedicated plan).
- SLA clause: uptime/latency credit equal to pro-rata portion of monthly committed fee for impacted minutes beyond SLA thresholds.
- Calculated credit: $4,755.00 (pro-rata for 27 minutes of degraded service, adjusted for our partial mitigation credit policy).

Notes:
- Calculation includes token-weighted adjustment for batched requests (we apply a 0.75 multiplier for batched inference units per contract).
- If we issue a credit note, bookkeeping suggests recording as a negative invoice line for October and issuing a PDF credit note.

Kim: please verify the impacted token counts used in the workbook (column D). If those numbers are confirmed, I'll route for Vanessa's approval (amount > $2,500 requires ops sign-off per policy).

Attachment: credits_calc_v1.xlsx (xlsx stub)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: SLA credit request — Boreal Data (calc attached)

Marcus / Hannah —

Verified the telemetry slice used in the workbook. Column D token counts match the per-customer KV cache keys and request logs for 03:20–03:47 UTC. I also confirmed that approximately 40% of affected requests were from batched jobs (we used the 0.75 multiplier accordingly).

Recommendation: proceed with the $4,755 credit and prepare a formal credit note. There is no contractual reason to escalate to legal.

Will create a concise evidence bundle (timestamped logs + aggregated traces) for Boreal to attach to their internal audit if requested. I'll upload that to Drive and share the link.

Kim
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SLA credit request following Oct 2 API latency spike — proposed credit and issuance

Hi Janelle / Samir —

Thanks again for sending the timeline and for your patience while we completed our review. Based on our internal telemetry and the SLA formula, Redwood is prepared to issue a credit of $4,755.00 to Boreal Data for the Oct 2 latency event.

What we'll provide:
- A PDF credit note (credit-note-2027-10-09.pdf) for accounting, showing the negative line item and referencing INCIDENT-2027-10-02.
- Evidence bundle (timestamped logs and aggregated traces) uploaded to the Drive link shared above.
- A DocuSign envelope to formalize acceptance of the credit note (link below).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm the pay-to account on your side for applying the credit (invoice number to apply against or open account credit).
2) Janelle/Samir: sign the credit acceptance via DocuSign so we can close this out on our billing system.

We aim to apply the credit on the Oct invoice cycle. If you prefer an immediate invoice adjustment, let us know and we'll prioritize the bookkeeping change.
